acceptance_status: Open: selected checkpoint has no eligible drills or adopted rules, and team case review has not occurred.
accepted_case_requirements: Explicit age 13-17 and meaningful request; missing-age application tests belong to Step 30.
Recorded preparation and second-teammate review; drafting assistance does not substitute for either review.
Reviewed family and partition, private expectations, and source/newly-authored detail lineage.
Feasible cases need a reviewed feasibility record using approved activities, adopted rules, and required lookup operations.
Intentional conflicts remain expressible; structural validation does not establish feasibility or category correctness.
authoring_policy: Record new dates, grade, resources, participants, and other additions as authored fiction; do not recover or infer them from missing source fields.

family_policy.new_base_families: Assign a partition before creating variations; prefer distinct final base cases.
family_policy.review: Check provenance, exact and near duplicates, meaningful facts, and parent-child links; shared formatting or goals alone do not establish a family.

food_policy: Use supported factual composition and quantity questions. Record final food-question coverage before freezing; athlete nutritional needs remain outside this field.
generation_status: No study profiles generated by this contract cell.

missingness.zero_or_false: stated value where the field permits it; never a missing-value replacement

model_assisted_drafting: If used later, save model identity, prompts, settings, and generated drafts; saved reviewed files define the benchmark.

public_boundary.private_expectation_schema: Prepare separately before case annotation; not part of this public schema.

publication_policy.before_private_writes: Establish ignore rules and inspect tracked paths; ignore rules do not protect already tracked files.
publication_policy.held_out: Final inputs, expectations, feasibility records, case-level manifests/reviews/lineage, and exact generation material that reconstructs final cases.
publication_policy.notebook_outputs: Keep final-case text and private case-level expectations out of public notebook outputs.
publication_policy.retrieval_and_prompts: Use explicit public-input allowlists; never scan evaluation directories into retrieval.
publication_policy.shareable: Schema, aggregate targets, and generic preparation procedures.
